items.title:
Who's giving this traditional Parkin bake a go? 👀

Ingredients

• 200g Deluxe butter, plus extra for greasing
• 225g golden syrup
• 85g dark brown sugar
• 250g self-raising flour
• 100g porridge oats
• 1 tbsp ground ginger
• 1 tsp mixed spice
• 1 large egg
• 60ml whole milk

Method

1. Preheat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan). Grease and line a 22cm square cake tin with baking paper.
2. Add the butter, golden syrup, and brown sugar to a large pan and cook over a gentle heat until melted together. Remove from the heat and allow to cool briefly.
3. In a bowl, mix together the oats, self-raising flour and spices.
4. Beat the egg and milk together in a small jug.
5. Stir the dry ingredients into the syrup mixture, then beat in the egg and milk until combined.
6. Pour the mixture into the prepared tin and bake for 50 minutes to 1 hour, until firm.
7. Leave to cool in the tin before cutting into squares and serving.
